text: He was impressed, I could tell. Then he asked me one question: "Can you cook a burger?" I have never cooked a burger. I have never even eaten one. I only wrap. I did not get the job. The letter said, "Thank you for wrapping my tie." Ah, almost, almost. So tonight, while they are out partying by the way, I am back in here learning to cook five AM two hundred burgers before breakfast. You are hired," he said. When can you start? I had already started.
